content.short: Thesauros lets fintechs, wallets and platforms embed stablecoin yield into their products.
content.description: Thesauros connects fintechs, wallets and platforms to stablecoin yield, so they can offer it inside their own products without building the DeFi integrations themselves. It is deployed on Plasma, a natural fit given the chain's stablecoin focus. Embedded yield of this kind is how most end users are likely to encounter on-chain returns.
